meta.subject: fixes: texture unit mem access sometimes going to smem, bilinear texture filtering; new: cache req_id,

en.summary: This very mixed commit still contains a clear DUT bug-fix: texture cache requests are given an explicit address-type field in the shared cache-tag layout so texture fetches are not misclassified as shared-memory traffic. The same commit also bundles broader bilinear-filtering work.
why_it_counts: The patch repairs shared cache-tag packing in central texture and memory-path RTL.
The fix directly matches the commit subject about texture accesses sometimes going to shared memory.
The bug mechanism is concrete and independently injectable even though the commit also includes filtering changes.
disqualifiers: The commit is very large and mixes routing fixes, bilinear filtering changes, debug req_id plumbing, simulator work, and runtime updates.
Not every modified texture-related file belongs to the same bug mechanism.
evidence: VX_define.vh introduces CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS and recalculates shared D-cache tag widths so LSU and texture paths reserve the same routing field.

VX_tex_mem.sv changes texture request tags from a minimal req_texel_idx encoding to a packed tag that explicitly appends CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS set to zero, and it shifts response-field extraction accordingly.
VX_lsu_unit.sv switches request and response tag packing and extraction to use CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS consistently.
The commit subject explicitly says texture unit memory access sometimes going to smem.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When several memory clients share one cache or memory fabric, low tag bits are often reused to encode request type or destination space such as cacheable, non-cacheable, or shared-memory traffic. If one client omits those reserved routing bits from its tag and instead uses the same positions for an internal request index, some requests will be decoded as belonging to the wrong memory space or their responses will be unpacked using the wrong field boundaries.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An auxiliary client such as a texture unit issues requests through a shared cache path where tag bits also encode memory-space type or downstream routing.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove or misplace the reserved address-type field in that client's tag encoding so internal tag bits overlap the routing-classification bits.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit reserved routing bits from shared cache tag
portability_notes: This applies to any design where multiple clients share a cache port and response routing depends on tag subfields.
A good target is a client that should always issue ordinary cache reads and therefore should drive the address-type field to zero.
Reinject both the request tag packing bug and the matching response-field extraction bug so the tag layout is consistently wrong.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the shared cache-tag format and identify which low bits encode memory-space or route classification.
In the auxiliary client, pack its internal request ID or texel index without reserving or zero-filling those classification bits.
Adjust response unpacking to read the client-local ID from the pre-shift location, matching the faulty packed layout.
Issue requests whose internal tag bits take on nonzero values in the overlaid classification field and observe misrouting or misassociation.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: shared D-cache tag packing between texture requests and LSU or shared-memory routing
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix standardizes CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS in the common tag format, makes LSU tag extraction use that width, and changes VX_tex_mem to pack texture request tags with an explicit zero-valued address-type field while shifting response-tag decoding accordingly.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_tex_mem.sv, revert the texture tag from the explicit {req_id, LSU_TAG_ID_BITS'(req_texel_idx), CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS'(0)} style layout back to a compact client-local tag with no reserved address-type bits, and decode rsp_texel_idx from the old lower-bit position. Pair that with the old shared-width assumptions from VX_define.vh or VX_lsu_unit.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A subset of texture fetches are classified as the wrong memory-space traffic or are decoded with the wrong tag layout on response, leading to wrong texel reads, stalls, or accesses being diverted toward the shared-memory path.
evidence_for_injection: The fix is grounded by explicit tag-format changes rather than inferred from tests alone.
Texture request tags previously lacked reserved address-type bits even though the shared cache path used those bits for routing.
The response extractor in VX_tex_mem was also shifted, showing that tag-field positions were part of the real bug.
notes: The same commit also contains bilinear filtering fixes, but the tag-layout bug is the cleanest reusable injection target.
The mutation_strategy label here denotes removing the reserved routing term from the shared tag format, not a handshake bug.

zh.summary: 这个非常混合的提交中仍然包含了一个明确的 DUT 修复：纹理缓存请求在共享 cache tag 布局中获得了显式的地址类型字段，因此纹理取数不会再被误分类为 shared memory 流量。同一提交还打包了更大范围的双线性过滤修改。
why_it_counts: 补丁修复的是纹理与内存路径核心 RTL 中共享 cache tag 的打包方式。
这个修复与提交标题中“texture access 有时会跑到 smem”直接对应。
尽管该提交还混入了过滤相关改动，但这个 bug 机制本身清晰且可独立注入。
disqualifiers: 该提交规模很大，混合了路由修复、双线性过滤改动、debug req_id 连线、模拟器修改和运行时更新。
并不是每个与 texture 相关的修改文件都属于同一个 bug 机制。
evidence: VX_define.vh 引入了 CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS，并重新计算共享 D-cache tag 宽度，使 LSU 与 texture 路径保留相同的路由字段。
VX_tex_mem.sv 把纹理请求 tag 从只包含 req_texel_idx 的最小编码，改成了显式附加零值 CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS 的 packed tag，并相应调整了响应字段提取位置。
VX_lsu_unit.sv 也改为统一使用 CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS 来做请求和响应 tag 的打包与提取。
提交标题明确写了 texture unit memory access sometimes going to smem。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当多个内存客户端共享同一个 cache 或内存 fabric 时，低位 tag 往往会被复用来编码请求类型或目的空间，例如 cacheable、non-cacheable 或 shared-memory 流量。如果某个客户端没有在 tag 中保留这些路由位，而是把同样的位置拿去存放自己的内部请求索引，那么部分请求就会被解码成错误的内存空间，或者响应会按错误的字段边界被拆包。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 共享 cache tag 的路由分类
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 像纹理单元这样的辅助客户端通过共享 cache 路径发请求，而 tag 位中同时还编码了内存空间类型或下游路由。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除或错放该客户端 tag 编码中的保留地址类型字段，让内部 tag 位与路由分类位发生重叠。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit reserved routing bits from shared cache tag
portability_notes: 适用于任何多个客户端共享 cache 端口且响应路由依赖 tag 子字段的设计。
一个理想目标是本应始终发起普通 cache 读的客户端，因此其地址类型字段本应固定为零。
要同时回注请求 tag 打包错误和对应的响应字段提取错误，使整个 tag 布局一致地错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到共享 cache tag 的格式，并确认哪些低位用于编码内存空间或路由分类。
在辅助客户端中，直接打包其内部请求 ID 或 texel 索引，而不为这些分类位保留或清零位置。
把响应拆包逻辑也改回从旧的低位位置读取客户端本地 ID，以匹配错误的 tag 布局。
发起那些内部 tag 位会在重叠分类字段上取非零值的请求，并观察错误路由或错误关联。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 纹理请求与 LSU 或 shared-memory 路由之间共享的 D-cache tag 打包逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在公共 tag 格式中统一了 CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS，让 LSU 的 tag 提取使用这个宽度，并修改 VX_tex_mem，使纹理请求 tag 显式带有零值地址类型字段，同时相应调整响应 tag 的解码。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_tex_mem.sv 中，把纹理 tag 从显式的 {req_id, LSU_TAG_ID_BITS'(req_texel_idx), CACHE_ADDR_TYPE_BITS'(0)} 这种布局改回没有保留地址类型位的紧凑客户端本地 tag，并把 rsp_texel_idx 改回从旧的低位位置提取。再配合恢复 VX_define.vh 或 VX_lsu_unit.sv 中旧的共享宽度假设。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 部分纹理取数会被分类为错误的内存空间流量，或者在响应侧按错误 tag 布局解码，进而导致 texel 读取错误、停顿，甚至被错误导向 shared-memory 路径。
evidence_for_injection: 这个修复是由显式的 tag 格式改动支撑的，而不是只靠测试推断。
在共享 cache 路径使用这些位做路由的前提下，纹理请求 tag 之前确实没有保留地址类型位。
VX_tex_mem 中响应提取字段的位置也同步发生变化，说明真正的 bug 就是 tag 字段边界错误。
notes: 同一提交里还有双线性过滤修复，但 tag 布局 bug 是最干净、最可复用的注入目标。
这里的 mutation_strategy 表示从共享 tag 格式里删除保留路由字段。
